scope: Primary player implementation; semantic inspection only,no code copied into fvid.
observations: noteCut0 handles EC0 on tick zero after note/instrument triggering, setting real and output volume to zero with a quick volume ramp.
noteCut handles ECx on nonzero ticks when elapsed tick equals the low-nibble argument.
Unlike keyOff, noteCut does not set the key-off flag; a later volume setter can restore the existing sample voice.
